data.creator_notes:
Hey folks...

This is an alternative version of my previously posted character generator, but with more of an emphasis on NSFW content.

As with my last character generator, this is a bot that can be used to generate definitions for your OWN bots. Because really... making bots can be time consuming if you're doing it all by hand. THIS will automate at least some of the process, and make your bot-creating endeavors easier, more streamlined... and... you don't even have to navigate away from CHUB.

I'm aware that others have created similar mechanisms, which is fine. This one is simply MINE; and it uses MY style of formatting in it's output. Simply ask it for a random character or a character with some specific details; any traits not specified by YOU will be automatically populated to complete the character profile.

This isn't some ground-breaking accomplishment on my end; just a little something to help some other folks around here create more and better bots. Well... at least I think so, anyway. Keep your request simple, such as 'please provide a definition for a (gender)(species)' or 'please provide a definition for a (gender)(species) with (whatever else you'd like to include)'.

Be advised that you'll likely need to hit the little 'right arrow' at the top, next to the 'trash' icon to get it to finish generating the entire character definition.

Anyway, give it a try! Let me know what you think... hope you like this. Stars & subscribe if you do!

-Enoch-

P.S.... the example character definition here in THIS bot belongs to an upcoming release of mine. Stay tuned!
